channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula: queda de sigilo vai desmascarar quem fez "putaria" junto com Vorcaro
item.description: Lula advocates for lifting the secrecy of the Master Case to expose alleged corruption and connections between Vorcaro and politicians, criticizing Minister Andre Mendonça for selective leaks. During a speech in Curitiba, he stated that the Bolsonaro family will not escape investigations and reinforced the need for judicial reforms.

item.title: Relatório da PF sobre “Dark Horse” contraria versão de Flávio
item.description: The Federal Police report on the funding of the film 'Dark Horse' contradicts Flávio Bolsonaro's version by indicating that the Havengate fund was inactive before the $2 million transfer in 2025. The PF notes that the fund, originally created for real estate purposes, was revived to finance the production, while Flávio claimed it was exclusive to the film.

item.title: Novas frentes de investigação: Vorcaro usou agência de luxo para beneficiar 'dezenas de autoridades' em viagens no exterior, além de Ciro Nogueira, aponta PF
item.description: Federal Police investigate evidence that banker Daniel Vorcaro used a luxury agency to distribute benefits to dozens of officials during international trips, including Senator Ciro Nogueira. Investigators requested documents from the Supreme Court to identify all beneficiaries, expanding the Master case investigations.

item.title: França chama Tarcísio de “Kinder Ovo” com surpresinha “bolsonarista”
item.description: Márcio França (PSB), Haddad's running mate, labeled Tarcísio de Freitas as a 'Kinder Egg with a Bolsonarist surprise', criticizing his technical image and health policies. França questioned the effectiveness of Tarcísio's anti-drug crackdown and noted the tight race between candidates.

item.title: Internado com pneumonia, Ronaldo Caiado diz que terá alta no domingo (13/9)
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) was hospitalized with pneumonia at Hospital Vila Nova Star in São Paulo and is expected to be discharged on Sunday (13/9). He will resume his electoral campaign on Monday (14/9).

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis neste fim de semana (12 e 13)
item.description: Presidential candidates mobilize their bases over the weekend with rallies, caravans, social gatherings, and health events such as breast cancer awareness. The schedule includes regional actions, leafleting, roundtable discussions, and visits to vulnerable communities. The main figures involved maintain neutral stances in public statements.

item.title: PF e PGR pediram sigilo de investigação sobre Flávio
item.description: The Federal Police and the Attorney General's Office initially requested the secrecy of the investigation into Flávio Bolsonaro over suspicions of irregular funding for the film 'Dark Horse', but Minister André Mendonça of the Supreme Court removed the secrecy. The case involves legal and political investigations that may affect the lawmaker's trajectory in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Gleisi e Janja chamam Moro de “algoz” de Lula
item.description: Gleisi Hoffmann and Janja da Silva criticized Sergio Moro, calling him 'executioner' of Lula during a rally in Curitiba, linking his imprisonment to Lava Jato. The statements were made without naming Moro directly, but making clear references to his conviction and Lula's imprisonment.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da decisão de Fachin que separa casos de Moraes e Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court Chief Justice Edson Fachin rejected Minister Alexandre de Moraes' request to unify the hearings of Petitions 16.704 and 16.662. He decided to keep the analysis of Petition 16.662 separate and scheduled Petition 16.704 for September 23rd.

item.title: Os ataques do governo a Jorge Messias e como governo e AGU criaram estratégia para Fachin sair da inércia
item.description: The government and AGU devised a strategy for Supreme Court Justice Edson Fachin to intervene and reverse the ruling removing Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues, amid political pressure and criticism of Attorney General Jorge Messias. The case involves allegations of clandestine monitoring of Justice André Mendonça and suspicions of bias in the fake news investigation, fueling tensions between the PT and the STF leadership.

item.title: 'Crise Master' no STF: em Curitiba, Lula diz que 'ninguém pode ser ministro da Suprema Corte para ficar rico'
item.description: During a campaign in Curitiba, Lula stated that no one can be a Supreme Court minister to get rich, treating the position as a sacred role. He emphasized that his son Lulinha will not be shielded in ongoing investigations and called for full transparency in the Master case. The Supreme Court is examining messages exchanged between justices and former banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Fachin marca julgamento sobre conduta de Mendonça no Master para dia 23/9
item.description: The President of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), Minister Edson Fachin, scheduled for September 23, 2026 the trial regarding the conduct of Minister André Mendonça in the Master case. Fachin denied Alexandre de Moraes' request to jointly try PET 16.704 with other investigations. The trial will be conducted by the Plenary, analyzing Mendonça's conduct during the rapporteurship of PETs 15041 and 15556.

item.title: Fachin nega julgar Moraes e Mendonça juntos; marca outra sessão para dia 23
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin rejected the request to jointly try ministers Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, keeping September 15 for Moraes and scheduling September 23 for Mendonça, citing that the second process is still under preliminary investigation.

item.title: Fachin nega pedido para julgar Mendonça junto com Moraes e marca outra sessão para o dia 23
item.description: The President of the STF, Edson Fachin, denied the request to judge Minister Alexandre de Moraes together with former banker Daniel Vorcaro, keeping only the investigation against Moraes in the December 15 session. A new session was scheduled for December 23. The decision maintains focus on analyzing the minister's conduct and his possible relationship with the owner of Banco Master.

item.title: Janja e Gleisi dançam com “onça”, e Lula ri durante ato em Curitiba
item.description: At a campaign rally in Curitiba, President Lula laughed alongside Janja and Gleisi as a jaguar - used as Gleisi's campaign mascot - danced on stage. The event is part of the PT's tour through southern Brazil, including stops in Porto Alegre and Curitiba, where Lula was imprisoned in 2018 on corruption convictions later annulled by the Supreme Court.

item.title: Gilmar reforça pedido para liberação dos dados de celular de Vorcaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes requested the release of Daniel Vorcaro's phone data to STF President Edson Fachin, arguing that asymmetric access undermines parity among ministers in the case analysis. Gilmar emphasized the need for all ministers to have full access to information to form independent judgments, threatening to involve the Federal Police if access is not granted. The case is linked to corruption investigations involving the Master bank.

item.title: Padilha diz que Tarcísio mente: “61% da Tabela SUS Paulista vêm da União”
item.description: Minister of Health Alexandre Padilha accused São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas of lying when claiming credit for funding the SUS Paulista table, stating that 61% of the resources come from the federal government. Padilha attended the launch of Fernando Haddad's program and emphasized that the model already existed in previous administrations.

item.title: Fachin nega julgar Moraes e Mendonça juntos e marca sessão do relator do Master para 23 de setembro
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin rejected Alexandre de Moraes' request to merge investigations against him and André Mendonça. Tuesday's session will address only messages between Daniel Vorcaro and Moraes, while Mendonça's conduct analysis is scheduled for September 23. Moraes claims there's a risk of contradictory decisions if cases are separated.

item.title: Vorcaro se gabou de proximidade com governo Lula: ‘Igual irmãos Batista’
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro referenced his proximity to the Lula administration, comparing himself to the Batista brothers of J&F, in a conversation revealed by O Estado de S. Paulo. The dialogue occurred after criticisms of Banco Master and was part of an investigation into the institution. Vorcaro suggested using the mention of government ties as a marketing strategy.

item.title: A preocupação da campanha de Lula com queda nas pesquisas em Minas Gerais
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign is concerned about declining poll numbers in Minas Gerais, where Flávio Bolsonaro surpassed the PT candidate in the latest Quaest survey. The institutional crisis involving the STF and Daniel Vorcaro is impacting Lula's performance, particularly due to his ties with Minister Moraes. The campaign views Minas as a strategic state given its large independent electorate.

item.title: Brics critica medidas comerciais unilaterais em cúpula da Índia
item.description: BRICS countries criticized unilateral trade measures and protectionist barriers at a summit in India, calling for the strengthening of the WTO. Leaders such as Xi Jinping and Narendra Modi emphasized the need for cooperation and adherence to multilateral rules.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio tentou tirar investigação de caso Dark Horse de Dino
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's lawyers attempted, at least four times, to move the 'Dark Horse' case investigation to Justice André Mendonça, but Justice Flávio Dino retained part of the probe under his jurisdiction. The dispute involves suspicions of money laundering, currency evasion, and misuse of parliamentary amendments linked to the film's production. The defense accuses a supposed manipulation of competence rules to create an artificial preemption of Dino.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro arranca e iguala o desempenho do pai nos três maiores colégios eleitorais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) matched his father Jair Bolsonaro's performance in the three largest electoral colleges (SP, MG, and RJ), reaching a 4 million vote advantage over Lula, according to a Quaest poll. In SP, he leads with 41% against Lula's 33%; in MG, he overtook the petelist president, who dropped from 38% to 37%.

item.title: A coincidência que une Lula e Flávio na última pesquisa Datafolha
item.description: Lula and Flávio are tied at 46% in rejection, according to Datafolha from September 8-10. In the runoff simulation, Lula leads with 46% against the senator's 44%. The survey was conducted during the STF crisis.

item.title: Presidenciável na mira da PF: Flávio é investigado no STF por 4 crimes
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro is under investigation by the Federal Police for four crimes: corruption, money laundering, criminal organization, and currency evasion, tied to financing of the Dark Horse documentary. The STF-approved probe, opened under pressure from justices following selective leaks, directly impacts his presidential campaign. The case forces the candidate to explain the source of funds and justify his ties to investigated figures.

item.title: O dia ‘d’ da democracia brasileira
item.description: The text criticizes the Supreme Federal Court and Minister Alexandre de Moraes for sentencing ordinary citizens to long prison terms over alleged illegal acts during the January 8 events, highlighting a perceived imbalance in judicial enforcement and institutional power abuse. The author draws parallels between cases like Débora dos Santos and Alcides Hahn and powerful figures who avoid similar consequences, exposing deep structural inequality in Brazilian citizenship.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio pediu 4 vezes para Mendonça relatar caso “Dark Horse”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense requested four times the Supreme Court for Minister André Mendonça to take over the 'Dark Horse' case, trying to remove the report from Minister Flávio Dino. The requests, made between July 13 and 29, 2026, were unsuccessful, and Federal Police carried out an operation against 29 people in the investigation authorized by Dino.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes pede que Fachin libere íntegra de dados do celular de Vorcaro
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes requested the STF president, Edson Fachin, to release the full data from Daniel Vorcaro's phone to all ministers participating in the trial of Petition 16.662. The content may contain relevant information about a possible connection between Vorcaro and Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Na TV, Lula sobe o tom sobre segurança e mira quatro “inimigos”
item.description: Lula intensifies his tone on public security in a new electoral broadcast, presenting concrete proposals and identifying four 'enemies' to combat: traffickers, male abusers, cell phone thieves, and 'crime magnates'. The piece links enforcement to the approval of the Security PEC and highlights measures such as intelligence reinforcement, expansion of Celular Seguro, and the transformation of state prisons.

item.title: “Lula, Xandão e Flávio vão ter que responder pelos crimes deles”, diz Renan
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from Missão, accused Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Alexandre de Moraes, and Flávio Bolsonaro of crimes in the Master case scandal, and attacked Supreme Court justices for allegedly protecting the interests of banker Daniel Vorcaro. He emphasized his anti-corruption stance and criticized judicial influence over politics.

item.title: A linha do tempo das conversas de Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro e o financiamento de ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Federal Police investigations reveal alleged contacts between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro regarding funding for the biographical film 'Dark Horse', suggesting the candidate concealed his closeness to the former banker. Messages indicate demands for payments and involvement of figures linked to the Master scandal.

item.title: Douglas Ruas cresce nas pesquisas e busca colar a imagem à de Flávio para acelerar
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL) faces challenges in recognition but aims to accelerate using Flávio Bolsonaro's image as leverage in the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial race. With three weeks left, Ruas must close the gap on frontrunner Eduardo Paes (PSD), while strengthening his association with Flávio. The strategy includes joint appearances and media exposure to attract right-wing voters.

item.title: Sobrevivência no sufoco: Lula resiste à crise do STF, mas sem folga real
item.description: Lula leads poll with 39% versus 35% for Flávio Bolsonaro, but narrow margin leaves PT candidate on survival threshold. High-risk reelection scenario with abstention among low-income voters and elderly.

item.title: Os problemas enfrentados por Augusto Cury no voo solo da terceira via
item.description: Augusto Cury, presidential candidate from Avante, led third-route polls with 11% voter intent, but saw support drop to 9% a week later. Despite tying technically with Lula in head-to-head simulations, his campaign failed to consolidate enough strength to threaten Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff, but is expected to play a decisive role in it.

item.title: Na reta final, disputa acirrada entre Lula e Flávio acende alerta na campanha petista
item.description: In the final stretch of the 2026 elections, Flávio Bolsonaro leads second-round projections, leveraging the Supreme Court crisis and directly attacking Lula. The PL candidate held a large rally in São Paulo and criticized minister Moraes, while Lula faces institutional pressures affecting his campaign.

item.title: Lula sanciona com vetos lei que cria fundo para a DPU
item.description: President Lula signed into law the bill creating the fund for the structuring and strengthening of the DPU, with vetoes by the federal government on provisions regarding revenue sources and immediate effectiveness. The new mechanism aims to expand the provision of free legal aid and the defense of individual and collective rights of the low-income population.

item.title: Campanha de Lula dirá na TV que Flávio Bolsonaro não pode combater crime por ter relação com investigados
item.description: Lula's campaign will air TV ads questioning Flávio Bolsonaro's ability to fight crime, citing alleged ties to investigated individuals like Daniel Vorcaro. The ads will also criticize his handling of inflation. The content will air on December 9, 2026.

item.title: OpenAI cria mecanismo de alerta para eleições de 2026
item.description: OpenAI submitted its compliance plan for the 2026 elections to the TSE, outlining measures to prevent ChatGPT from favoring candidates, recommending votes, or being used in large-scale political campaigns. The plan includes AI-generated content detection mechanisms and monitoring for potential abuses during the electoral period.

item.title: Vorcaro prometeu “prioridade total” para financiar ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro promised advertising executive Thiago Miranda on October 22, 2025 to prioritize funding for 'Dark Horse', a film about Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio Bolsonaro was pressuring Vorcaro regarding the production's payments.

item.title: Gilmar reforça pedido de acesso a conteúdo do celular de Vorcaro e solicita a Fachin que acione PF caso Mendonça não repasse
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes reinforced the demand for full access to Daniel Vorcaro's phone data, insisting all STF ministers be granted access and asking Fachin to compel the police to release files directly if rapporteur André Mendonça refuses. The move aims to prevent judicial imbalance and ensure transparency in evaluating messages between Vorcaro and Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: PT admite que não é fácil tirar Moraes do 'colo do Lula'
item.description: Lula stated that Moraes, if guilty, must pay, which the PT interprets as a sign he is distancing himself from the STF minister. The remark, made in an SBT interview, unfolds amid 2026 elections and the controversy surrounding Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Speaking in Porto Alegre, Lula states that no foreign president should interfere in Brazilian elections and stresses he has never engaged in electoral interference abroad. He underlines the need for a civilized relationship with the United States and reaffirms his commitment to electoral sovereignty.

item.title: Campanha de Lula espera fim do inferno astral após revelações do Dark Horse
item.description: Lula's campaign hopes the Dark Horse investigations against Flávio Bolsonaro will end a period of vulnerability and revitalize his electoral strategy following weeks of damaging crises.

item.title: São Paulo busca quebrar sequência positiva do rival nos últimos confrontos
item.description: São Paulo aims to break Palmeiras' positive streak in upcoming clashes, following two consecutive wins in the Brazilian league. The match takes place at Nubank Parque, with São Paulo targeting a Libertadores spot. The team is 14th with 33 points, while Palmeiras leads with 53 points.

item.title: Red Bull Bragantino visita o Botafogo pelo Brasileirão
item.description: Red Bull Bragantino faces Botafogo at Nilton Santos in the 27th round of the 2026 Brasileirão at 8:30 PM. The club aims to bounce back from two consecutive losses and features key players like Rodriguinho, listed as doubtful, with returns from Agustín Sant'Anna and Isidro Pitta.

item.title: Sérgio Macarrão, medalhista olímpico e vice-campeão mundial, morre aos 81 anos
item.description: Sérgio Macarrão, former Brazilian basketball player and Olympic bronze medalist in Tokyo 1964, died at the age of 81. He was a world championship runner-up in 1970 and represented Brazil in two Olympics, Tokyo 1964 and Mexico City 1968. His career included stints with clubs like Botafogo, Flamengo, Fluminense and Vasco, ending at Mackenzie in 1981.

item.title: Por sequência de vitórias, Santos recebe Cruzeiro na Vila Belmiro
item.description: Santos hosts Cruzeiro at Vila Belmiro in the 27th round of the Brazilian Championship. The host team seeks its third consecutive victory, while Cruzeiro aims to climb the standings. Santos will be without key players such as Neymar, Lucas Veríssimo and Álvaro Barreal.

item.title: Mesmo com mais mulheres na disputa, o acesso ao poder continua restrito
item.description: Despite an increasing number of female candidates, access to power in Brazil remains restricted, according to the Electoral Observatory, an initiative by Professor Leonardo Avritzer. The project, coordinated by UFMG and IEPI, monitors electoral issues and processes since 2018, based on academic and journalistic output.

item.title: Com crise no STF, Congresso quer votar reforma do Judiciário após a eleição
item.description: The STF crisis may drive a Judiciary reform after the 2026 elections. Lawmakers and judiciary members consider it inevitable to vote on changes to the rules of superior courts. A pending constitutional amendment proposes an eight-year term for Supreme Court justices and shared appointments among the branches of government.

item.title: Lula será único líder dos Brics fundadores fora de cúpula na Índia
item.description: Lula will be the only founding BRICS leader absent from the summit in New Delhi due to his election campaign, while the other leaders are confirmed to attend the event.
